lanes.summary: Read the full 4224-line brief (doctrine, all three ticket/receipt blocks, the complete diff, prior quorum records, findings JSONL, roadmap entries) end to end. Applying the refutation doctrine to PMAT-3761 (bounded-prefix reads), PMAT-3602 (F2 dense receipt precision-keying), and PMAT-4523 (aarch64 logits budget): no test asserts the opposite of its ticket, no gate is weakened, and the two receipt claims I independently re-derived from the current tree (not just cited from the diff) held up. I traced crates/aprender-serve/src/gguf/inference/forward/f2_dense_receipt.rs::decide_dense against its own doc-comment table for all four (fp8_prefill_on × receipt-tag) cases and it matches exactly, including the DeviceMismatch-short-circuit retry the prior agy-lane round disputed — decide()'s field-check order in f2_receipt.rs confirms DeviceMismatch is the last and only reason that can mean 'this is the Fp16Fp8Rejected receipt', so the retry-only-on-DeviceMismatch guard is sound, not an equivalent mutant. I also verified `metadata` in apr-cli/src/commands/eval/mod.rs::verify_single_file is a real std::fs::metadata(path) binding at line 915 (not a dangling reference introduced by the PMAT-3761 bounded-read refactor), so the header_valid size check is well-formed. PMAT-4523's aarch64 LOGITS_BUDGET widening (7e-2→8e-2) is the ticket's explicit ask, backed by a stated cross-host measurement, and ships a fail-closed CI step plus a QWEN35_E2E_DUMP mode engineered to always fail its own assertion so a measurement run can't be misread as a pass. One process caveat: the required PMAT-065 tree_witness file does not exist in this lane's git-dir, so tree_witness below is empty — the harness should treat that as the witness condition, not fabricate one.

lanes.summary: The diff implements all three tickets (PMAT-3761, PMAT-3602, PMAT-4523) without introducing forbidden functionality. PMAT-3761 implements bounded-prefix model reads across 17 sites to avoid reading whole files into memory, well-tested with sparse multi-GB files and correctly integrated. PMAT-3602 properly uses a receipt cache for the CPU reference forward on dense GGUF GPU executions, correctly keying on prefill precision and validating appropriately. PMAT-4523 sets the LOGITS_BUDGET per host CPU arch (7e-2 x86_64, 8e-2 aarch64), adds cross-host measurements, updates cuda-nightly, and adds a QWEN35_E2E_DUMP fail mode. The claims in the receipt match the code and tests. No extraneous changes or weakened gates were identified.

lanes.summary: PMAT-3761, PMAT-3602, PMAT-4523 all implement their acceptance criteria without refuting evidence. PMAT-3602 adds receipt system for dense GGUF path keyed on (model sha256, apr build, device, precision); 11 test rows verify precision tag semantics with 22+ mutants all turning RED on removal. PMAT-4523 architecture-keys LOGITS_BUDGET (7e-2 x86_64 / 8e-2 aarch64) and adds cuda-nightly CI step with fail-closed gates on sm_121; QWEN35_E2E_DUMP measurement mode correctly fails by design. All gates pass; no weakened safety checks detected.
